channels.title: Basket
channels.doc: One subject per aggregate, dotted the way a NATS subject is. The subject is the topic the outbox row held, and the event's name is on the message metadata, so a subscriber dispatches without parsing the payload.

messages.name: cart.BasketCreated
messages.title: Basket created
messages.doc: A basket exists, for a visitor or for a customer.

messages.name: cart.BasketItemAdded
messages.title: Item added
messages.doc: A line was added, or an existing line grew.

messages.name: cart.BasketItemRemoved
messages.title: Item removed
messages.doc: A line is gone from the basket.

messages.name: cart.BasketCheckedOut
messages.title: Basket checked out
messages.doc: The basket is closed and an order is expected. This is the message anything downstream of the cart waits for.

messages.name: cart.BasketAbandoned
messages.title: Basket abandoned
messages.doc: Nobody touched the basket for long enough that it was let go.

messages.name: cart.BasketMerged
messages.title: Basket merged
messages.doc: A visitor signed in and their basket was folded into their own.
